scope: Experiment design files only; selected cards.json read to verify six selected know_how values and source hash; catalog-projection.json allowed projection only. No original catalog, sealed/holdout, prior scripts or broad repository search.

findings.evidence: Receiver input fidelity is defined as actual delivered related atoms, but no input-atom enumeration, segmentation or denominator recording is provided. The template has only fixed atom_id records, mixing per-atom and response-level counts.
findings.impact: Evaluators can choose different denominators. A receiver faithfully repeating an incorrect sender claim can be confused with end-to-end correctness; per-response error counts can be duplicated across ledger rows.
findings.requested_change: Define dynamic actual-input atoms with quote/source, inclusion/segmentation/deduplication rules and explicit denominator; keep fidelity versus end-to-end and propagated misinformation separate. Provide role-level counts, per-claim evidence/deduplication and request-unit decomposition fields separate from fixed ledger judgments.

findings.evidence: F-CAU-U04 combines actual photo receipt and content confirmation. F-GR-P11 and F-CAU-P05/P08/P09/P10 combine status and time although most other status/time facts are split.
findings.impact: Partial preservation has no fixed decision boundary and atomic denominators use different granularity. Actual receipt can be known while content confirmation is unknown.
findings.requested_change: Split independently answerable state/time propositions before freeze, update counts/code, and specify how remaining context-bearing atoms treat partial preservation. Keep raw memos and role packets unchanged.

findings.evidence: The selected unchanged HPU support says '카탈로그 공급 관계에 맞춰' but no catalog is in the packet and all other file reads are forbidden. General unit/tag knowledge versus the torn note's unobserved unit is not concretely illustrated.
findings.impact: An evaluator could silently treat remembered catalog supply links or usual units as incident evidence, or mistake a reference instruction for an instruction to retrieve forbidden data.
findings.requested_change: Keep original know_how intact; explicitly record the unavailable catalog dependency and input-only evidence boundary. Add normal/error examples for guessed concrete supply links and assigning an unobserved unit versus clearly marked general knowledge or a verification question. State that referenced material is not authorization for another tool read.

confirmed: Six families HPU/GR/RT/CV/PDP/CAU, one preselected card each, 18 sender packets, six receiver templates, 54 unique planned pairs and three repeats per scenario-condition.

All three sender conditions have identical task/access_rule/notes JSON values; only support differs. none is empty, checklist is the same generic five items, t4 exactly matches selected original know_how and selection text.
Source memos are unstructured fragments with source gaps/conflicts and no answer-like checklist or oracle instructions. Blank lines separate memo fragments in .txt; they are not extra facts.
Receiver templates expose only task/access_rule/initial/handoff:null; protocol requires actual full sender output substitution and no other edits.
No semantic answer leakage from fact ledger/examples into roles identified. Support is the intended intervention and contains method guidance, not scenario observations.
Source cards SHA256 independently equals 37f6d48f8af765ba6f4adbd99ff7d9a0d80c7de441c0751d6c60ebe2ef443aff; selected version synthetic-f7c3411308f7.

Strict versus sensitivity negative-target rules, normal/ambiguous examples, independent second judgment, question types and independent answer units, and exactly two planned conversational turns are specified.
Fresh fork_turns=none, one packet read, no repeated contexts, unavailable tool-observation cases, and lack of OS isolation are explicit. Judge blinding limits are explicit.

Length confounding is disclosed as package effect; 1800 Unicode code points per output, basic108 roles, maximum216 attempts and194400 baseline requested characters are explicit; tokens/cost/total wall-clock enforcement unavailable.
Fixed order, stop criteria, infrastructure-only single retry, missing/ineligible handling, complete-triplet primary analysis and excluded-output supplementary reporting are specified.

Development lineage and non-generalization limits are explicit; later revisions require failure evidence, old/new versions, independent review and separately designed new situations before generalization evaluation.
verification: Independent structured comparison of all18 sender packets, all6 templates, selected source know_how, run cardinality and manual semantic reading of all6 memo sets and fixed atom entries. Author static checker read; this initial review is not a freeze or role execution.
